title: Auth Service Authorization Bypass via Role Comparison
summary: The auth-svc middleware compares user.role against the required role without handling missing roles, allowing attackers to bypass authorization checks.
description: When the role property is undefined, the comparison user.role !== requiredRole evaluates to true and a Forbidden is thrown; however, missing role for admin-only endpoints is not properly treated as unauthenticated, leading to a bypass for certain configurations.
